border-field.$description: The soft edge of fields (inputs, selects, textareas): the label and the sunken shadow identify them, and focus turns it Azul Aura

border-control.$description: The edge of an unchecked checkbox or radio: 3.38:1 on #F5F5F5 (WCAG 1.4.11), like the switch track

text-tertiary.$description: Darker than #9B9B9B so small labels stay readable: 5.1:1 on white, 4.7:1 on #F5F5F5

fill-accent.$description: The highlighted row of a menu, list or command palette (shadcn --accent): stands out from the white popover, unlike fill-secondary; text reads 17.2:1, text-secondary 5.0:1

focus-ring.$description: The focus halo: a 1px edge in Azul Aura (5.2:1 on white) inside a soft glow of it

success-foreground.$description: White reads 3.8:1 on the green; night reads 5.2:1

sequential-1.$description: Magnitude in Azul Aura, from near zero (1) to the most (9): heatmaps and cells. Labels: text on 1-5, the page color on 6-9

diverging-1.$description: Polarity around a neutral 5: red below (1, the most negative), blue above (9, the most positive). Labels: text on 3-7, the page color on 1, 2, 8 and 9

success-50.$description: The status scales are Tailwind's (success emerald, warning amber, info blue, error red). Tint 50-100, border 200-300, text 700 on 50, 100 and the surfaces, 800 on 200

raised.$description: Elevation 1, cards: a top-edge highlight, a contact and an ambient shadow

raised-hover.$description: An interactive card lifted under the pointer: the ambient shadow grows

control.$description: Elevation 1, filled and outline buttons, the active segment

control-hover.$description: A button lifted under the pointer

pressed.$description: A pressed button: the highlight turns into an inset shadow

sunken.$description: Fields: inputs, textareas and select triggers sit below the surface

overlay.$description: Elevation 2: popovers, menus, selects, chart tooltips

raised.$description: Laid over the card color: white at the top, a touch darker at the bottom

filled.$description: Laid over a filled button: lit at the top, the fill itself behind the label in the middle

glass.$description: Frosted floating surfaces: 80% white tint; the theme strengthens muted labels on glass
